head: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max AI model, weights stay closed
dek: Alibaba's new Qwen4-Max takes text, images and video and is available through its QwenCloud API, Qwen Studio, QwenWork and Qoder from 16 November. Unlike many earlier Qwen models, it can't be downloaded; Alibaba says smaller Qwen4 models will get open weights later.
